summary:
Toggle between zebra-striping and standard table layouts implemented with zero cell clipping.
- Added 1-click quick zebra toggle button directly on the editor's floating table toolbar.
- Integrated persistent 'Zebra-Striped Tables' default toggle in the Editor Typography & Settings dropdown backed by localStorage.
- Enforced zero cell clipping with minimum column widths, auto-clearing padding (0.65rem 0.9rem), 1.55 line-height, top vertical alignment, and safe word breaking.
- Added high-contrast zebra row support across all themes and in print/PDF exports.
